org.name: Name
group.name: Name
group.allAccessPermission.tooltip: Whether this group has permission to view all articles
role.name: Name
role.globalPermission.tooltip: Whether the role can manage global data, such as all organizations, all users and globally shared data
role.allArticlePermission.tooltip: Whether the role has data permission for all articles, regardless of the data scope
role.allChannelPermission.tooltip: Whether the role has data permission for all channels
role.allStatusPermission.tooltip: Whether the role has data permission for all statuses (e.g. editing approved articles)
role.dataScope.tooltip: Further restricts data permissions (such as article permissions) to all data, permitted organizations, the user's own organization, or the user's own data
role.permission.tooltip: The super administrator (ID 1) has all permissions
role.grantPermission.tooltip: Permissions that can be granted when creating or editing roles. The super administrator (ID 1) has all permissions
role.rank.tooltip: A smaller number means a higher rank. Users can only be granted roles of the same or a lower rank
role.type.tooltip: System administrator, security administrator and audit administrator form the three-administrator separation of duties
role.error.scopeNotAllowd: Already in use by other sites, so it cannot be set to private to this site
role.error.rankHigherThenCurrentUser: Rank is higher than the current user's
user.orgs.tooltip: The user also gains the site permissions and data permissions of the extended organizations
user.role.tooltip: A smaller role rank number means a higher rank. Users can only be granted roles of the same or a lower rank
user.mobile.twoFactorHint: Two-factor authentication is on: login codes are sent to this number, and admin users with a missing or wrong number cannot log in
user.rank.tooltip: A smaller number means a higher rank. Higher-ranked users can manage lower-ranked users, but not the other way round
user.error.passwordPattern.1: Password must contain letters and digits
user.error.passwordPattern.2: Password must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters and digits
user.error.passwordPattern.3: Password must contain letters, digits and special characters
user.error.passwordPattern.4: Password must contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits and special characters
user.batch.tip: One user per row; the username is required, everything else may stay empty. You can copy several rows and columns from Excel and paste them straight into the grid. The users belong to the chosen organization and rank one below yours.
user.batch.password.tooltip: Used for rows without a password of their own. If both are empty the users have no password and cannot log in until an administrator resets it
user.batch.empty: Fill in at least one user
user.batch.tooMany: At most {max} users at a time
user.batch.hasIssues: {count} row(s) have problems; no user was created. Fix them and submit again
user.import.tip: Upload an Excel sheet (.xlsx), one user per row; the username is required. Organization, user group, password and roles can be written per row or set here for the whole sheet; rows whose username already exists are skipped. Imported users rank one below you.
user.import.org.tip: Used when the sheet has no "Organization" column, or when that cell is empty in a row
user.import.group.tip: Used when the sheet has no "User group" column, or when that cell is empty in a row
user.import.password.tip: Used when the sheet has no "Password" column, or when that cell is empty in a row. If both are empty the users have no password and cannot log in until an administrator resets it
user.import.roles.tip: Used when the sheet has no "Roles" column, or when that cell is empty in a row; separate several roles with commas in the sheet. Roles can only be granted with the permission-settings permission
user.import.unknownHeaders: These columns are not recognised and were ignored: {headers}
user.import.done: Import finished: {created} created, {skipped} row(s) skipped, {failed} row(s) failed
user.roles.add.tip: Grants the chosen roles to every selected user; the roles they already hold stay. A role ranking above any selected user cannot be chosen.
user.roles.remove.tip: Takes the chosen roles away from the selected users; their other roles stay. Only roles held by the selected users are listed.
user.roles.noRoles: The selected users hold no roles
user.roles.hasIssues: {count} user(s) have problems; nothing was changed
